name: Zhe Jiang Headman Machinery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhe Jiang Headman Machinery Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of computer numerical control (CNC) lathes in China and internationally. The company offers multi-axis turning centers, vertical lathes, horizontal turning centers, T series gang-type tools, HCL series, and automation products. It also provides machining centers, industrial robots and workstations, and industrial automatic control system devices; and machine tools, auto parts and accessories, electronic components, building metal fittings, and plumbing parts.
